territories.name: Djibouti
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Djibouti levies a value added tax of its own under Loi n°43/AN/08/6ème L, now in the Code général des impôts 2016: article 187 sets the normal rate at 10 per cent with a zero rate for exports, article 176 exempts the operations it lists, and article 207 has the taxpayer file the return by the 20th of the month following.
